text: momentum: categorical trend direction derived from a metric's week-over-week percent change. Rising if change is greater than 10%, declining if less than -10%, otherwise flat.
pct_change: the percent change of a metric from the first to the last week in its 4-week window.
rating_velocity: weekly count of new product ratings for a competitor SKU - a proxy for purchase or attention velocity.
sell_through_rate: fraction of available self-catalog stock sold in a given week.
oos_weeks_out_of_4: count of weeks, out of the last 4, a SKU was flagged out of stock.
engagement: sum of likes and comments on an Instagram post - a proxy for social attention.
